info.description:
# Purpose

The Swisscom Sign *Integration API* enables backend systems to create, configure, release, and monitor digital signing processes end-to-end with minimal manual interaction.

Contact Support:
 Name: Support

item.name: Finalize process in Swisscom Sign UI

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the process to finalize via UI.

request.description:
Launches the Swisscom Sign web interface for the initiator to complete the process setup.
This includes defining visual elements and participant data.

Once setup is complete, the process is automatically released and notifications are handled by Swisscom Sign.

**Preconditions:**
- A process was created via `/process`.
- The process has not yet been released.

response.name: The setup request has been accepted. Please redirect to the provided URL.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the process to be released.

request.description:
Releases a previously created and fully configured process. Personal access URLs are returned for each participant.
These can be used for asynchronous execution, typically via email.

Optionally, you may include email parameters to notify participants directly.
Optionally, you may configure automatic reminder emails for pending participants.
Optionally, you may restrict the allowed signature methods (`APP`, `CLICK`, `OSS`, `PASSKEY`, `SMS`) via `signatureMethods`.
If omitted, the tenant defaults apply. Methods are validated against the document's signature level.

Preconditions:
- A process was created via `/process` with at least one participant.
- At least one document was attached using `/process/{processId}/attach`.
- Every signer must be placed on at least one document.
- At least one document must have all signers placed on it.
- All visual signatures are placed within the visible area.

variable.description: (Required) ID of the process to which the PDF will be attached.

request.description:
Attaches one or more PDF files to the specified process. You may repeat this call up to a maximum of 100 files.
Only `application/pdf` is supported, and each file must not exceed 40MB in size.

**Preconditions:**
- The process status must be `CREATED`.

response.name: The file has been attached successfully.
